# Qaftr

Qaftr is an Arabic-first invoicing app for freelancers and small businesses in Saudi Arabia. It helps users create ZATCA Phase 1 style tax invoices with QR codes, 15% VAT calculations, PDF export, client details, and Arabic or English invoice output.

## Core Pages

- Home: https://qaftr.com/
- Free tools: https://qaftr.com/tools
- ZATCA invoice tool: https://qaftr.com/tools/fatora
- VAT calculator: https://qaftr.com/tools/vat-calculator
- TRN checker: https://qaftr.com/tools/trn-checker

## Positioning

Qaftr is an independent invoicing product. It is not an official ZATCA application and does not replace tax, accounting, or legal advice.
